newsitem.title: RUSSIA: NOYABRSKNEFTEGAZ TO RAISE 1.8 TRLN RBLS - SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: NOYABRSKNEFTEGAZ TO RAISE 1.8 TRLN RBLS - SOURCE.

text.p: Russian oil firm Noyabrskneftegaz's board of directors approved raising 1.8 trillion roubles ($310 million) to pay off federal debts through a restricted share subscription, and will not have to transfer a controlling stake to the state, a source at the company said on Friday.

"This issue will help the company settle its debt without turning 51 percent of its shares to the government," the source said. "Noyabrskneftegaz has been ordered by the federal authorities to pay most of its debts by September 15," he added.
Its debts to the federal budget were 1.7 trillion roubles as of August 1, the source said.

Noyabrskneftegaz is the main production unit of oil holding company Sibneft. Earlier this week a Sibneft spokesman said the company had approved a Noyabrskneftegaz share issue to pay off debts, but gave no more details on the volume of the issue or the time scale.

Noyabrskneftegaz is one of many Russian energy companies heavily indebted to the government. The state has clamped down hard this year in a high-level drive to raise deperately-needed cash for state coffers.
Mini-major Sibirskaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya (Sibneft) produced 18.61 million tonnes of oil in 1996, down from 20.34 million in 1995.
